## PS2 (rebased onto current `origin/main`) — CI status

Patchset 1 took `Verified -1` on a job unrelated to this work:
`optionality … / terraform-config-inspect pinned canary`, with
`ERROR: file or directory not found: tests/unit/grounding/test_terraform_corroborator.py`.

Verified independently: that file is added by `59d504c2bdbb` ("Add terraform-config-inspect
corroborator", change 2672), which was NOT an ancestor of PS1; the canary job's definition
comes from trusted `main` while the tree it runs is the patchset, so it looked for a file PS1
legitimately did not contain. `_optionality.yml:334` on main even carries the assumption that
turned out false: *"the lane never runs against an older base that lacks
tests/unit/grounding/test_terraform_corroborator.py"*.

Rebased onto `origin/main` (`0033662b5534`) — clean, no conflicts, same Change-Id
`Id2568531d23355a2a306eb82652c6935c0f67ceb`, uploaded as patchset 2 of change 2673 (commit
`ca474fa29d92`). `LLM-Review +1` was copied forward as a trivial rebase.

PS2 run https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/actions/runs/33962708668 — **20 of 21 jobs green**,
including the whole gating pytest matrix. The one failure is again the canary, but now for a
DIFFERENT reason: the file is present (the job fetched `refs/changes/73/2673/2` and ran it),
and the canary fails on its own assertion:

```
>       assert positive.evidence["outcome"] == ev.OUTCOME_MATCH
E       AssertionError: assert 'abstain' == 'match'
tests/unit/grounding/test_terraform_corroborator.py:429
```

That is not specific to this change: the same assertion fails identically on an unrelated
dependabot PR run at 10:16 UTC (job 101290520693, `1 failed, 24 deselected`), whose
`pull_request` checkout merges current `main` and so also has the file. The canary is broken
on `main` and needs fixing forward there; nothing this change touches is on that path.

Still not closing: awaiting a clean `Verified +1` and merge.
